_README: Every place TaxFS's screens can do LESS than TaxOS's, with the reason.
A plain reason means DELIBERATE — TaxFS made a different, defended choice.
A reason starting with 'TODO:' means the capability is genuinely missing
and meant to come back; those print on every run and never expire quietly.
Nothing may be added here to silence the check. If it is not deliberate,
it is a TODO, and if it is a TODO it stays visible until it is fixed.

controls.address_line: G9: identity never reaches the server. Address is entered in the browser vault on File It and typed onto the PDF at download time.
controls.tax_year: TaxFS serves one season at a time (TAXFS_TAX_YEAR); there is no year picker to get wrong. TaxOS's second option existed only to demo an out-of-scope refusal.
controls.out_of_state: Equivalent, and stronger: TaxFS asks for an affirmative IL full-year residency attestation in the Interview (attestation.il_residency, packages/agents/src/gaps.ts) rather than a negative checkbox here. The scope guard exists; it moved.
controls.self_65: TODO: TaxOS ticked four boxes and derived the count. TaxFS asks the operator to compute the count themselves (addl_std_boxes 0-4), which is arithmetic the app should be doing. Restore the four checkboxes and derive the count client-side — the storage rule (count only, never who) is a G9 guardrail and must not change.
controls.self_blind: TODO: see self_65 — same four-checkbox control.
controls.spouse_65: TODO: see self_65 — same four-checkbox control.
controls.spouse_blind: TODO: see self_65 — same four-checkbox control.

buttons.Save filing identity (encrypted, local o: G9: identity moved to the browser vault on File It (identity-panel.tsx), which never sends it to the server at all — stronger than TaxOS's encrypted local file.
buttons.Delete filing identity from this machine: G9 — the vault's own clear/forget control replaces it.

controls.kind: Same control, named 'concept' — and constrained to the registered concept list rather than a free string.
controls.override: TODO: TaxOS let the operator say 'my typed value is correct, the document differs from the scan' and proceed. TaxFS refuses a mismatch and offers nothing, so a misread number is a dead end. Restore the override WITH its recorded reason - the point is that the operator's reading wins over the machine's, on the record.
controls.source_ids: TODO: TaxOS could tick several documents and remove them in one pass (one recompute at the end). TaxFS removes one at a time.

buttons.Delete: Same button, worded 'Remove' — and it covers manual entries too.
buttons.uploaded: Not a button: an extraction artifact from the 'uploaded' badge inside TaxOS's stub-upload button.
buttons.Delete selected: TODO: bulk delete — see the source_ids control.
buttons.Delete file: TODO: TaxOS listed ORPHANED files (in storage, referenced by nothing) and let the operator remove them. TaxFS has no orphan sweep, so a half-finished upload leaves a file nothing points at.
buttons.Batch-confirm routine items: TODO: TaxOS could confirm a batch of routine low-risk readings in one action. TaxFS confirms one at a time, which is right for a low-confidence value and tedious for a 40-line brokerage import. Any restoration must keep type-to-verify on anything below the confidence floor.
buttons.Connect my IRS account transcript (demo): TODO: TaxOS had a stub IRS Wage & Income transcript connect that cross-checked uploaded documents against the transcript. TaxFS assembles transcript reconciliation into the Defense File but has no intake path for the transcript itself.

controls.value: TODO: THE BIG ONE. TaxOS let the operator type a corrected amount straight onto the Review line and save it. TaxFS has no way to correct a value before filing at all — a misread or mistyped number can only be fixed by deleting the whole document and re-uploading. The spine already carries amendSourceField() with its audit row; no screen calls it.

buttons.Save: TODO: the save for the inline correction above.

controls.reason: TODO: TaxOS required an explicit unlock WITH a recorded reason before a locked package could be superseded (D.5). PackageStore.unlock(package_id, reason) is ported in @taxfs/forms and enforces it; the screen never calls it, so buildLockedPackage inserts a new version unconditionally and no reason is recorded anywhere.

buttons.Assemble Defense File from the locked pa: Same capability, as a download link ('Download Defense File') rather than a build button — TaxFS assembles on demand instead of storing a built bundle.
